newsitem.title: USA: Grill Concepts sees sales up by 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Grill Concepts sees sales up by 15 pct.

text.p: Grill Concepts Inc on Monday it opened its new Daily Grill restaurant in Washington, D.C., and it expects the unit to boost company wide annual sales by as much as 15 percent.
The restaurant, the company's first in Washington, D.C., should outperform the average of all Daily Grill restaurant sales by over 20 percent, Grill Concepts said in a statement.
The company operates eight Daily Grill restaurants in and around Los Angeles, Orange County and Palm Desert in Calif. In 1996, it reported sales of $22.7 million.
